summary.value: Action: Opposed (MIG + WLP) Check against a creature you can touch.

system.description: Action: Opposed (MIG + WLP) Check against a creature you can touch. On success choose exactly one: drain HR Hit Points and recover half; or inflict dazed/shaken/slow/weak and treat the matching Attribute die (INS/WLP/DEX/MIG) one size higher until they recover — capped at d12. Heals you directly; never touches the Well. Counts toward the two-effect cap.
